items.title: Crypto steadies as Iran-U.S. pause sends oil tumbling, lifts risk assets
items.summary: Brent crude plunged 7% after the U.S. and Iran paused Strait of Hormuz strikes, lifting equities and DeFi tokens while bitcoin held near $65,000 ahead of a pivotal Fed decision Wednesday.

items.title: CFTC issues second warning to prediction markets on cookie-cutter self-certifications
items.summary: For the second time this year, the regulator told prediction markets to stop issuing overly broad, template-style certifications of events contracts.

items.title: Democratizing weather derivatives through tokenization could be crypto's most important real-world use case
items.summary: Main Street, which faces the most significant climate-related financial risk, currently lacks an avenue to hedge weather-related risks, argues CoinDesk’s Omkar Godbole.

items.title: Wise to resubmit US bank charter application under GENIUS Act
items.summary: The OCC denied the UK company’s application this week citing AML/CFT risks, despite approving similar charters for digital asset companies in the last year.

items.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong criticizes crypto startups that rebrand to AI
items.summary: Armstrong said blockchain technology acts as a general-purpose infrastructure that will underpin future automation rather than competing with it.

items.title: Interest rates in U.S., U.K., Japan and Coinbase, Strategy earnings: Crypto Week Ahead
items.summary: Your look at what's coming in the week starting July 27.

items.title: Cloud data firm Storj files for Chapter 11, extending a week of crypto failures. Token slides 16%
items.summary: The decentralized data storage company says operations continue and proposes that token holders take equity in the restructured business — an unusual arrangement in bankruptcy.

items.title: Live updates: Ether leads crypto higher. China's gold imports surge
items.summary: CoinEx's Jeff Ko sees bitcoin staying range-bound near $65,000 while retreating oil, a 4.7% 10-year yield and a week of mega-cap earnings set the tone.

items.title: Crypto is the canary in the coal mine for the quantum computing threat, experts say
items.summary: As estimates for “Q-Day” move closer, experts warn that crypto’s slow governance, not its cryptography, may be the biggest obstacle to defending against quantum attacks.

items.title: Bitcoin is back above $65,000 as U.S. and Iran hold fire. Oil drops 5%
items.summary: ETH outperforms BTC, hinting at potential altcoin rally, as the U.S. and Iran hold fire and oil drops.

items.title: South Korea trading giant puts receivables onchain in tokenization test with LG CNS
items.summary: POSCO International and LG CNS is tapping Injective network to tokenize live commercial invoices, another sign blockchain rails are moving deeper into corporate finance.

items.title: BNY Mellon unit joins MiCA register as ESMA adds 15 providers
items.summary: BNY Mellon’s European subsidiary joined the MiCA register as ESMA added 15 CASPs, including banks and crypto platforms, in the third post-deadline update.

items.title: Brazilian police bust cocaine traffickers in crypto-linked transnational probe
items.summary: Brazilian police suspect the group of shipping around 6.5 metric tons of cocaine and laundering billions in Brazilian reals through crypto-enabled illicit money brokers.

items.title: Coinbase CEO touts agentic finance as Base tops 100M AI payments
items.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong says AI agents will expand crypto adoption, pointing to Base, USDC and x402 as key pieces of agentic finance.

items.title: Triple-A confirms treasury-wallet breach after losses reach $11.8M
items.summary: The stablecoin payments company said client funds were unaffected and that the financial impact would be absorbed through its treasury reserves.

items.title: BitMart withdrawals appear to slow following wind-down announcement
items.summary: Users reported withdrawal delays and freeze notices as wallets attributed to BitMart fell to about $69 million and its BMX token extended an 81.5% weekly decline.

items.title: Garden Finance disables app as Blockaid reports $450,000 exploit
items.summary: Garden Finance said no user funds or smart contracts were affected after an attacker compromised an independent solver’s off-chain database and inserted fraudulent swap records.
